spans.s:
उक्त p. p.
1 Said, spoken.
--2
Uttered, spoken (opp. to अनुमित or
संभावित).
--3 Told, addressed;
असावनुक्तोऽपि सहाय एव

.
--क्तं
A speech, words collectively; a
sentence.
--क्तं --क्ता A stanza of
four lines with one syllabic instant,
(there being one long or two short
syllables in each).
--Comp.
--अनुक्त a. spoken and not spoken.
--उपसंहारः a brief description,
rèsumé, peroration, recapitulation.
--निर्वाहः defending an assertion.
--पुंस्कः a word (feminine or neuter)
of which also a masculine exists,
and the meaning of which differs
from that of the masculine only by
the notion of gender.
--प्रत्युक्तं
speech and reply, discourse.
--वाक्यं
a dictum, decree.

उक्तिः f.
1 Speech, expression,
statement; उक्तिरर्थांतरन्यासः
स्यात्सामान्यविशेषयोः

.
--2 A sentence.
--3 The
power of expression, the
expressive power of a word; as in
एकयोक्त्या पुष्पवंतौ दिवाकरनिशाकरौ Ak.
